findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the tenths for any count that parseSessionReport accepts (up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) are exact. Actual: the 2000*part product goes above the safe-integer range once counts exceed about 4.5e12, so the rounding could be off by one for such counts. No real session gets near this.
findings.fix: Optional: cap stored style counts at a realistic bound (e.g. MAX_SESSION_COUNT) or compute with quotient/remainder so large values stay exact.
